units.text: Choose one authoritative API contract model and avoid independently maintained canonical contracts that can drift.
Treat migrations as executable changes to production state rather than ordinary source edits.
Resolve the authoritative actor/relationship, authorize the action plus resource at the protected boundary, then perform the operation and return only necessary data.

When rotating words suit the approved marketing message, keep the lead phrase steady and rotate complete words in a clipped stable slot independently of photo scenes. Provide server-readable H1, no-JS/reduced-motion fallback, visible pause for all autoplay, independent timers and no duplicate intervals. Do not confuse timed whole words with magnetic letter hover.
Keep focused editable content and required actions reachable and visible when virtual keyboards, fixed navigation, sheets, or safe areas reduce the usable viewport.
Repeated mobile capture/search loops must keep focused input, result selection, Enter/IME behavior, and the next required action usable without requiring manual keyboard dismissal.
Keep routine mobile continuation steps within one overlay/surface; do not stack routine dialogs, sheets, or popovers without a distinct safety reason.
Do not log secrets, authorization tokens, or unnecessary sensitive payloads; treat telemetry volume, retention, PII, and cardinality as production concerns.
What practical retry, rollback, forward-fix, repair, restore, degradation, or operator recovery path exists for each material production risk?

Use the product's semantic light/dark tokens and render its authoritative saved theme from the server. Put the accessible sun/moon switch at the far right of the persistent header; use a feature-detected decelerated curtain transition with immediate reduced-motion/API fallback and truthful persistence rollback. On desktop, start the sidebar as a 72–80px compact rail unless explicitly pinned; reveal labels transiently on hover or keyboard focus with decelerated motion, keep pin/unpin separate from hover, retract after pointer exit even after unpin, and do not reflow tables on hover. On mobile use a named focus-managed drawer with Escape and focus return. Keep header, sidebar and tenant state stable through modest route-content transitions and skeletons; do not add a decorative global footer. Reuse existing primitives and honor the current DESIGN.md and authorization boundaries.
Do not copy one global performance threshold across unrelated products; define numeric budgets only when repeated regression risk and a stable measurement justify them.

For a public client website, implement an accurate first-screen offer, site-specific desktop/mobile image prompts, transparent-to-readable header with real contact actions, intentional service/gallery and demo-safe reviews when useful, working validated quote flow and legal/SEO scope. Use canonical hero/gallery/reviews patterns; never fabricate project photos as client jobs or Google reviews.

When a gallery is warranted, implement a semantic selectable expanding-photo row on desktop with discoverable inactive labels and a mobile scroll-snap rail plus matching detail panel. Support pointer/touch/keyboard, no-JS and reduced-motion; use site-specific images and titles.

Implement the chosen two-row or one-row public review marquee from pat-public-client-reviews-marquee with semantic original cards, inert clones, readable mobile layout, visible pause and reduced-motion/static mode. Fictional examples need section-level and per-card disclosures; no fabricated provider attribution, aggregate or JSON-LD.
Classify connectivity-sensitive behavior as offline-capable, cached/read-only, or network-required and define synchronization semantics before reporting offline mutation success.
Do not add a service worker merely as a PWA badge; its lifecycle and caches become production behavior only when a concrete capability justifies them.
Which immutable commit or build identity is being promoted, to which environment, and how will the target identity be verified before environment-changing work?
Do not run local or demo reset/seed behavior against Production as ordinary release setup.
Where is authorization for the affected action and resource enforced at an authoritative server or data boundary?
What scope, expiration or revocation, transport, storage, and reissue semantics protect the affected bearer credential?
Prefer full-length immutable commit SHAs for third-party GitHub Actions, especially when workflows have secrets, write permissions, or deployment authority.
Do not give untrusted pull-request or fork execution production secrets or privileged deployment credentials.
When the server only needs to verify a presented random token and does not need to recover it, prefer storing a cryptographic verifier or hash rather than the raw token.
Do not intentionally place credentials in source control, analytics payloads, error messages, normal logs, or unredacted screenshots and evidence.
Describe capabilities only at the strength actually supported by the environment being discussed.
Production must not silently substitute mock or local persistence merely to make a workflow appear successful.
Target applicable user-facing web content to WCAG 2.2 AA and preserve keyboard operation, visible focus, meaningful naming/order, reflow, and non-color-only semantics.
Visible collection filters must be real predicates across rows, pagination, counts, and exports; clear or reconcile retained selection when a new predicate excludes it.
Preserve required information and actions at narrow widths and do not hide real layout defects with global overflow clipping.
Assert the intended semantic UI state before capturing visual evidence; filenames or action attempts are not proof that the state was reached.
